limitations.call_bound: Limits.turns and the outer counter count ymp invocations, not internal native API requests or retries.
limitations.deadline: Use one external absolute deadline and cancellation for the complete condition; no whole-condition deadline exists in Limits.
limitations.effort: Use AgentExecutionPolicy.fixed model and low; Codex sends both thread config and turn effort. Reconfirm native catalog and actual sent/reported observations before a measurement.
limitations.independent_context: Fresh native contexts and distinct solving directories avoid provided peer history. Native filesystem isolation from sibling directories is not established by cwd.
limitations.mcp: Engine.executable must point to current ymp, or a research command must delegate to the existing mcp::stdio_bridge; the default eval-driver has no mcp subcommand.
limitations.membership: Pinned Engine IDs are assignments/contexts; no claim of exactly N model workers is available while native children remain uncontrolled.
missing_controls: TurnRequest/NativeResourceControls expose no proved Codex native-subagent disable control
Engine.use_memory=false disables ymp retrieval/learning, not native provider memory or inherited native configuration
Limits.attempts=1 disables ymp task/review repeats, not Codex willRetry or internal model requests
ProviderConfig.args can carry verified native settings, but accepted names and enforcement for these controls have not been established
limitations.raw_review_reserve: Storage retains one protected review invocation even for raw calls. The outer cap is exact; the captured storage ceiling adds one unused reserve without mislabeling raw work as final_review.
limitations.token_bound: Observed input+output is an admission/stop threshold. Native in-flight token overshoot has no proved finite bound.
